message: Live Windows 2.2.15 evidence: the delayed-composer wait/resume logic reached the intended migration path, but after reinstall/restart the previously marked rebind page no longer existed. Logs: rebind=resume_legacy, rebind=resume, then rebind=resume_failed reason=missing_page. Current persisted state is therefore the 2.2.15 migration failure shape: old saved control URL still bound; rebind_status=failed; rebind_count>=1; rebind_bootstrap_sent=false; rebind_failure_reason=missing_page; rebind_resume_count>=1/rebind_resume_status=failed. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.16 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) Add exactly one URL-scoped replacement-rebind migration allowed ONLY for this specific missing-page state: same saved old control URL, failure_reason=missing_page, bootstrap not sent, resume already consumed, and no successful rebind. It must not apply to no_composer/signed_out/hard_unavailable/no_new_url/goto/unexpected_url or arbitrary failed states. (2) Before any new_page call persist a separate replacement latch, e.g. rebind_replacement_for_url, rebind_replacement_count=1, rebind_replacement_status=started. A restart or later poll must never create a second replacement page. If status=started and an existing marked replacement page is found, resume only that page; if it is missing, fail closed and do not create another. (3) On the first eligible missing-page migration, create at most one fresh service page, mark it before navigation, go to ChatGPT home, wait up to the existing 20s for composer hydration using the 2.2.15 wait, gate signed_out/hard_unavailable, send CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP exactly once only after composer readiness, require a real new usable /c/ URL, atomically persist it with replaced_from, preserve recovery/bootstrap/GitHub history, clear blank/restore latches, and mark replacement done. Never persist '/'. (4) Do not navigate or reuse unrelated conversation pages. Existing unrelated ChatGPT tabs must remain untouched. (5) Replacement failure stores a stable token and permanently consumes the replacement attempt for that old URL; no tab growth on later polls/restarts. (6) Tests must cover the exact current 2.2.15 missing_page state => one replacement page; latch written before new_page; successful delayed-composer replacement => bootstrap once/new URL persisted; restart during replacement with marked page => resume same page/no new tab; restart with started latch but missing page => fail closed/no new tab; all other failure_reason values => no replacement; unrelated conversations untouched; repeated polls => no second page. Preserve CHECK_INTERVAL=5, 2.2.10 raw->api failover, text-free logs, main and arena/local-agent-v0 unchanged, no Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=49 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests and replacement semantics.
